parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that contains the topics you want to query.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags that are attached to the topic. A maximum of 20 tags can be included in the list.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The name of the topic that you want to query. This parameter is required if you want to query a specific topic. If you do not include this parameter in a request, all topics that you can access are queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-topic-list --topic test --instance-id MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --tag Value=ServiceA Key=CartService --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsTopicList --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key CartService --InstanceId MQ_INST_1880770869020000_BXSuW61e --Tag.1.Value ServiceA --Topic test
